name: Exelon
description: Exelon is a transmission and distribution holding company (wires and pipes): it owns six regulated utilities (ComEd in northern Illinois/Chicago, PECO in Philadelphia, BGE in Baltimore, and Pepco, Delmarva Power and Atlantic City Electric in the Mid-Atlantic) that deliver electricity and, at PECO, BGE and DPL, natural gas. Customers can buy the power itself from competitive suppliers and the utilities just bill and deliver it. Profit is the allowed return on rate base set by state commissions (authorised ROEs about 8.9 to 9.9 percent on distribution, up to 11.5 percent on FERC transmission). The companies plan about $41 billion of spending over four years, which they project adds about $23 billion to current rate base by the end of 2029.

businessLines.name: ComEd (Commonwealth Edison)
businessLines.how: Regulated delivery charges under a multi-year rate plan with annual reconciliation to actual prudent costs, plus FERC formula transmission rates; earnings grow with rate base, and customers pay the power cost as a pass-through.
businessLines.description: Electric transmission and distribution in northern Illinois including Chicago; purchase of power for retail customers

businessLines.name: PECO
businessLines.how: Regulated delivery of electricity and gas through base rates; PA approves a revenue increase without a stated ROE.
businessLines.description: Electric and natural gas delivery in southeastern Pennsylvania including Philadelphia

businessLines.name: BGE (Baltimore Gas and Electric)
businessLines.how: Regulated delivery under a multi-year plan with approved annual revenue increases (electric $41M, $113M, $25M in 2024-2026).
businessLines.description: Electric and natural gas delivery in central Maryland including Baltimore

businessLines.name: Pepco Holdings (PHI): Pepco, Delmarva Power (DPL), Atlantic City Electric (ACE)
businessLines.how: Regulated delivery through base rates and multi-year plans; revenue requirement increases approved in rate cases.
businessLines.description: Electric (and at DPL, gas) delivery in DC, Maryland, Delaware and New Jersey

businessLines.name: Other (corporate, shared services, eliminations)
businessLines.how: Internal service charges; a cost centre including Exelon interest expense.
businessLines.description: Holding-company costs and shared service entities
